ns2:course.label: Honors Uncommon Reads
ns2:course.description: Fosters student inquiry, civic engagement, and leadership through an interdisciplinary exploration of current issues in society. Students will acquire knowledge of current issues, identify connections to their academic major, and increase their motivation to challenge the society in which they live. Prerequisite: Restricted to Honors LLC students.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Restricted to Honors LLC students.
